headline: Asset groups gain a documented ceiling of just under 2,000 per tenant
summary_md:
- **Asset groups** picks up an Important hint stating there is a limit of just under 2000 asset groups.
- That is the day's only documentation change: one page, one added note, nothing removed, renamed or reordered.
- No navigation manifest or book page counts moved.

highlights.title: A limit of just under 2,000 asset groups is now stated in the docs
highlights.detail: An Important hint added above the dynamic and static asset groups section says there is a limit of just under 2000 asset groups; the page gives no other detail about how the ceiling behaves.

items.xsiam/detect-investigate-and-respond-to-: Adds an Important hint that there is a limit of just under 2000 asset groups, placed after the Access Management scoping note.
